synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a recall and −78% EPS-revision hit a franchise still growing double-digit with rising absolute EBITDA and forward-multiple compression.

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA is not decaying: it has RISEN from $15M (FY23) to $52M (FY24), $54M (FY25) and $61M LTM — a falling/steady margin % masks a doubling+ of absolute profit, so the low EBITDA multiple attaches to a rising, not shrinking, base.

bull_points.claim: Top-line growth is intact and mechanism-backed: management reported Q1 2026 constant-currency revenue growth of 12% with revenue rising to $459M LTM, driven by On-X and stent grafts.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Artivion, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The core valve franchise is compounding share: Q1 2026 On-X grew 17% constant-currency on global share gains and a new ~$100M US opportunity in under-65 patients.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: Artivion, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The aortic-arch portfolio is being completed by real regulatory catalysts: the FDA approved the NEXUS Aortic Arch System (April 2026), enabling the Endospan acquisition option and a claimed multi-cohort US TAM.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Key Developments: Artivion Inc NYSE AORT Key Developments.rtf · Apr-07-2026

bull_points.claim: Consensus forward EBITDA still shows a step-up to FY26E $95.3M and FY27E $115.6M, so the forward multiple (NTM TEV/EBITDA 12.8x vs LTM ~20.6x) compresses on growth, not decline.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (FY26/FY27 consensus EBITDA, latest snapshot)

bull_points.claim: The peer discount on TEV/EBITDA (name 18.4x vs peer median 24.6x) sits against a HETEROGENEOUS 10-name set spanning $39M–$66.1B (1682x), so whether the gap is a value trap or an overshoot cannot be read cleanly off the median — the composition itself gates the comp.

bull_points.claim: On the fundamentals that would EARN a discount, the name is NOT worse: EBITDA margin matches peer median (13% vs 13%), revenue growth is higher (18% vs 14%) and EBITDA growth is far higher (42% vs 21%) — leaving the residual open to an overshoot reading for the human to judge.

business_description.value: Artivion, Inc. manufactures, processes, and distributes medical devices and implantable human tissues worldwide. The company offers On-X prosthetic aortic and mitral heart valves; On-X ascending aortic prosthesis; CarbonAid CO2 diffusion catheters; Chord-X ePTFE sutures; pyrolytic carbon coating services; E-vita Open NEO, a hybrid stent graft; Arcevo, an LSA hybrid stent graft system; AMDS hybrid prosthesis; and NEXUS ONE, an endovascular stent graft system. It also provides NEXUS DUO, an aortic arch system; NEXUS TRE, a custom-made three branch graft; E-vita thoracic 3G, a stent graft system; E-xtra Design Engineering, a range of stent graft systems for the treatment of aortic vascular diseases, such as TAAA and Artivex; E-nside, a multibranch stent graft system; E-tegra, an AAA stent graft system; E-ventus BX and Tuva BX balloon-expandable peripheral stent grafts; and E-liac, a stent graft used to treat aneurysmal iliac arteries. In addition, the company offers synthetic vascular grafts that are used in open aortic and peripheral vascular surgical procedures; BioGlue, a surgical sealant; CryoValve SG pulmonary heart valve; CryoPatch SG pulmonary cardiac patch; SynerGraft, a decellularization technology; vascular preservation services; and PhotoFix, a bovine pericardial patch fixated. It markets its products and preservation services primarily to physicians through a direct sales team to hospitals and other healthcare facilities. The company was formerly known as CryoLife, Inc. and changed its name to Artivion, Inc. in January 2022. Artivion, Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Kennesaw, Georgia.
